----Petitioner
 Versus
1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp

2. Birma Ram S/o Surta Ram, B/c Meghwal, R/o Vill.
 Jambhshakti Nagar, Raneri Teh.

For Petitioner(s) : Mr.R.J.Punia, Adv.
For Respondent(s) : Mr.S.K.Bhati, Pp
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Garg
Order 19/09/2023

The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the accused-petitioner for quashing of FIR No.162/2023 registered at P.S. Bap, Distt. JodhpurRural for offence under Sections 323, 354, 447 & 376/511 of IPC.
After hearing the learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the material available on record, I am not inclined to quash the FIR.

However, liberty is granted to the petitioner to file a representation along with the documents before the concerned Superintendent of Police and the Investigating Officer within a period of two weeks from today, who shall consider all the facts as well as contentions raised in the representation and complete the investigation strictly in accordance with law.
[2023:RJ-JD:30574] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-5223/2023] The instant misc. petition is disposed of accordingly.
Stay application is also decided accordingly.
